stimuli.description: Five representative sound sources: speech, traffic noise, natural sound, air-conditioning noise, and music. Ambient environment as reference. Varied SPLs (45-65 dBA) for traffic and AC noise, and varied RTs (0.3-1.5 s) for speech and music.
Visual graphics for multitask visual cognitive tasks (visual search, graphical memory, location memory).

tables.description: Comparisons of measured and preset SPL values for Traffic noise and Air-conditioning noise.
Questionnaire items for personal information, Eysenck Personality Test E-Scale, Weinstein Noise Sensitivity Scale, and Music Listening Frequency.
Characteristics of participants (gender, personality, noise sensitivity, music listening regularity).
Spearman correlation coefficients between SPL (Air-conditioning noise, Traffic noise) and work performance (Reaction time, Search results, Graphical memory, Location memory).
Spearman correlation coefficients between RT (Speech, Music) and work performance (Reaction time, Search results, Graphical memory, Location memory).

limitations: The study chose only two noise sources (traffic noise and air-conditioning noise) for SPL investigation due to experiment complexity and length, limiting the scope of SPL effects explored.
Future work should extend the types of sound sources (positive effects such as natural sound or music) on SPL and explore their mechanisms.
